The §aSteam-Powered Water Pump§k§f is the way to generate a §aLOT§f of water in the Steam Age.
It needs §91000L§f of steam to perform one operation, and outputs §b10L§f of §9Low Pressure Steam.§f

Steam can be inputted through a normal GT Pipe, however, due to LP Steam being an §bNTM Fluid,§f it must be extracted using a §9Fluiduct§f into a §bBarrel.§f

Water can be extracted most easily through §bCurvy Pipes.§f
